summary: This month, our bathroom design team dives into the Ultimate bathroom statement piece - The Freestanding Bath. Considerations, style, inspiration and everything between.
title: The Complete Guide To Freestanding Baths
bodyHtml:
The bathroom is one of the few spaces in the home that should evoke a sense of private sensuality and wellness. In an age of high paced work and busy family life this has become more important than ever, the need to create a space of respite, a place to realign.
 

There is no other piece in the bathroom that can elevate the room to this level like a freestanding bath can. It is the ultimate statement piece and the one place left in a busy home to truly spend quality time with ones' self.

A freestanding bath instantly introduces luxury, elegance and refinement to the bathroom. They are the quintessential hero piece and have many advantages from a practicality point of view too.

What (exactly) is a freestanding bath?

A freestanding bath is a bathtub that can stand on its own without panels or wall mounted support, and without the need to be inset, so they can be placed anywhere space and water inlet/drainage access allows.

They either have a flat base and are placed directly on the floor (often with the assistance of adjustable levelling feet) or in more traditional styles, are mounted on legs so they are slightly elevated from the floor.

Freestanding baths come in a range of materials from acrylic, stone, fibreglass, cast iron, cast stone, and solid surface.

Freestanding Baths are Easier to Install

Compared to inset or built in baths that usually need a frame to be constructed first with tiling and other trades required to be involved prior to the bathtub being fixed in place, increasing the likelihood of damage. A freestanding bath offers an easier process and can be installed once the floor has been completed.

Our Lust Freestanding Bath in Semi Gloss White - See this Bath here

Enhanced Bathing Experience

Freestanding baths usually have a deeper internal area compared to other bath styles meaning the bathing experience is much more immersive and comfortable.

Space allowing, a freestanding bath is also very practical as it can be accessed from most sides making it easier for bathing children or assisting with people who have issues with mobility.

What styles of Freestanding Baths are available?

Freestanding baths are available in any style to fit your desired aesthetic. From copper clad baths, and federation baths complete with ornamental Claw feet, to luxe contemporary pieces with clean lines or sensuous curves, there’s something for everyones taste.

Freestanding baths are also available in a multitude of colour options from painted surfaces to material shades and textures so you can let your design spirit run wild and create the centrepiece you desire.
